title: Rapid state change -- crisis flag arriving mid-action
edgeCase: Edge Case 5 -- action invalidated by new information
description: A lower-severity crisis flag produces an in-flight (still 'proposed') HIGH-tier escalation. Before a clinician acts on it, a second, higher-severity message arrives for the same patient.

input.firstPatientMessage: Nobody would notice if I just disappeared for good.
input.secondPatientMessage: I want to kill myself tonight.

expectedBehavior: The first escalation action must be superseded (not silently left 'proposed' alongside a second, contradicting draft) once the second, higher-priority crisis flag is raised -- proving actions are a real lifecycle, not an append-only log.
